title: Anthropic Prices IPO at $83 a Share, Valued Near $1.5 Trillion
dek: The Claude maker beat its own price range ahead of Thursday's Nasdaq debut.

facts.label: Revenue in the first half of 2026

caption:
The first frontier AI lab to go public just priced its shares above the top of its range. 🚀

Anthropic, the maker of Claude, set its IPO at $83 per share, beating the $70 to $78 range it pitched to investors, according to multiple reports. That values the company at roughly $1.5 trillion, close behind SpaceX's June listing. Shares begin trading Thursday on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT, and Google and Nvidia are among seven partners buying $26 billion in stock at the IPO price.

The draw is growth: revenue jumped from $386 million in 2024 to about $16.3 billion in the first half of 2026 alone. The risks are big too. Anthropic reported a net loss of about $80 billion for the first half of 2026, carries $6.2 billion in debt and has roughly $900 billion in computing commitments.

We're tracking ANT's first trading days at AI Parabellum. Would you buy in, or wait for the hype to settle?
